description: Queues a post to be published at a future time (run_at, ISO 8601 with timezone, up to 365 days ahead) through the connected accounts. Takes the same content fields as publishing now. Every platform must already be connected and media must suit each platform, or it is refused now instead of failing later. When a platform is connected in more than one brand and brand_id is omitted, nothing is queued and the error lists the brands. Returns the queued item with its id and, for each platform, the handle and brand it will publish to. A queued post can be canceled before it runs.

brand_id.description: Brand whose accounts to use; omit for the default brand.

label.description: Optional short label shown in the PostWire queue.

media.description: Several images (or images and videos) in one post, in order: an Instagram carousel (up to 10), TikTok photo post (up to 35 images; PNG is converted to JPEG automatically for Instagram and TikTok), Bluesky (up to 4 images), Mastodon (up to 4), LinkedIn (up to 20 images, or one PDF document). Networks that take one item get the first. Each item: { url, type: image|video|document, alt? }.

alt.description: Alt text (used by Bluesky, Mastodon and LinkedIn).

url.description: Public https URL of the file.

photo_url.description: Public https URL of an image.

privacy.description: Who can see the TikTok and YouTube posts: public, unlisted (YouTube), friends (TikTok mutual followers) or private. Without it a TikTok post goes out private (only the account owner sees it) and YouTube uses the channel default — send "public" to publish publicly.

run_at.description: When to publish, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. "2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00".

text.description: Post text for platforms without a per_platform draft.

video_url.description: Public https URL of a video (YouTube needs one; TikTok takes a video or photos).

name: schedule_post
title: Schedule a post
